description: 한국전력공사_한전ON 자주묻는 질문답변(FAQ) [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국전력공사. 한국전력공사 한전ON에서 제공하는 자주 믿는 질문답변(FAQ) 데이터 입니다. 순번, 조회수, 업무분류, 업무분류명, 등록일, 제목, FAQ분류 항목으로 구성되어있습니다. The portal shows 2025-08-27 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
